comparison.objective: Route a curved board edge using a starting pin and bearing-guided feed.
comparison.physical_skill: Brace and pivot a board onto a bearing, then feed a curve in the safe direction while controlling hand clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Required curve length routed, board clear and released, with no off-pin first bite, climb cut, re-entry, or hand hazard.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is continuous workpiece guidance around a cutter with kickback constraints, unrelated to damper adjustment mechanics.
